Let's explore how to leverage these tools for seamless transactions in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and beyond.

content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

You can set up your digital commerce stack today using free tools and infrastructure that bypass the traditional barriers imposed by payment platforms. Start by choosing a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to showcase your products. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, which allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. By following straightforward deployment steps, you can create an operational store and begin accepting payments in under 48 hours.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The ideal minimum viable stack consists of a few essential components: a hosting service, backend logic, product storage, and payment processing. Using Cloudflare Pages for hosting ensures your site is fast and reliable. Utilize Google Apps Script for backend logic, while Supabase or Google Sheets can serve as your order storage. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, allowing you to accept payments in cryptocurrencies like USDT on the Tron network, which settles in under 60 seconds for less than $0.10.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Avoid getting bogged down in unnecessary complexities at the beginning. Focus on deploying your store with essential functionality first. You do not need advanced features like extensive marketing automation or detailed analytics right away. Concentrate on ensuring that your payment processing works flawlessly and that your products are easy to access for buyers. Once your core infrastructure is in place and you have transactions flowing, you can then expand and refine your setup.
Leverage blockchain to eliminate payment barriers in West Africa.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To initiate your first transaction, ensure that your digital products are uploaded and your payment options are correctly configured. Share your store link across social media platforms or with your existing audience. Consider promoting through local channels to attract initial buyers. As you finalize your product offerings and test payment confirmations, you will build confidence in your system. Remember, the speed of blockchain payments means that you can receive funds almost instantaneously, strengthening the buyer's trust in your service.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, your goal should be to finalize your product offerings and ensure your payment gateway is operational. Begin by creating an account with NOWPayments and integrating it into your store. Upload your first three products, and ensure your site is live on your chosen hosting platform. Promote your store link to friends and potential customers, emphasizing the ease of payment through cryptocurrency. By the end of this period, aim to make your first sale.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies effortlessly.

Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html and take control of your digital product sales today.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
